info.value: 1.944 dalivalisKaliraRiDvanitrapikzapayaSceti BojaH iti gaRasUtreRa Bojamatena mit .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to be ashamed, to be abashed,to be embarrassed, to shy

examples: 'nApatrapeta praSnezu nAviBAvyAM giraM sfjet' (BA॰SAM॰93.10). nyAyanizWuramuttaraM dadyAdityarTa iti nIlakaRWaH.
'ya AtmanA'patrapate BfSaM naraH sa sarvalokasya gururBavatyuta' (BA॰u॰33.121).
'krUreRa nApatrapase kaTaM Sakreha karmaRA' (BA॰u॰9.34). Asu sarvatrodAhutizvapaSabdena nArTaH kaScidupajanyate. lajjA sA'patrapAnyata ityamaroktirapi sApavAdA, ihEva ya AtmanA'patrapata ityukteH.
'na vyapatrapase nIca karmaRA'nena rAvaRa' (rA0 3.53.3). vyapatrapase apatrapase jihrezi lajjase vrIqyasi.
